facts.fact: Section 17 of the AML/CFT/CPF (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2026 (Act No. 3 of 2026, assented 17 April 2026) amends the National Payment Systems Act (2018), adding rights of judicial review of Bank of Mauritius administrative penalties and actions against operators, participants and payment service providers, so that Act is in force and applied by the central bank.
